title: Certification of Terminal Illness

blocks.text: I certify that the patient named above is terminally ill, with a medical prognosis of a life expectancy of 6 months or less if the terminal illness runs its normal course, based on my clinical judgment regarding the normal course of the patient's illness.
Specific clinical findings and other documentation supporting a life expectancy of 6 months or less are filed in the patient's medical record with this certification.
Physician's narrative explanation of the clinical findings
